name: 按依赖顺序扩展模型和命令行
description: 先扩展领域模型，再让命令行消费新行为，验证依赖任务的正确顺序。

files.content:
import argparse
from src.project import normalize_name

def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('name')
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    print(normalize_name(args.name))
    return 0

from src.cli import main
from src.project import project_slug

def test_slug_normalizes_name():
    assert project_slug(' My Demo App ') == 'my-demo-app'

def test_cli_prints_slug(capsys):
    assert main(['My Demo App', '--slug']) == 0
    assert capsys.readouterr().out.strip() == 'my-demo-app'
